responsibility: Implements GCC’s central tree-level constant folder and algebraic simplifier for GENERIC and GIMPLE expressions. This file owns the broad collection of fold routines that build or rewrite expressions, fold arithmetic, comparisons, conversions, pointer arithmetic, constructors, builtins, and conditionals, manage overflow-warning deferral, and cooperate with generated match patterns and gimple folding so front ends and middle-end passes can canonicalize expressions into simpler trees or constants.
same_name_distinction: This is the main implementation file for the fold-const stem: it performs general tree expression folding and simplification across many expression kinds; unlike gcc/fold-const-call.cc it is not limited to calls, and unlike gcc/fold-const.h it contains the core algorithms rather than the exported declarations.
